capability: Quotes: a business buyer's request for a quote, and the quote the store returns (BigCommerce B2B Edition Quotes, request-for-quote, Quoting & CPQ)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: its B2B Edition API groups Quotes (management and storefront, the latter at rest/b2b/storefront/request-for-quote), webhook topics store/quote/* and the product line Quoting & CPQ. No statement defines a quote beyond these names; that the buyer requests it rests on the path request-for-quote, a reading. Under CM-B2B-001 because B2B Edition's scope store_b2b_manage names quotes among its data (BC-S-0196).

capability: Shopping lists: a business buyer's saved lists of products to order again (BigCommerce B2B Edition Shopping List, Requisition lists & reordering)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: B2B Edition's API groups Shopping List (management and storefront) and the product line Requisition lists & reordering. Not defined beyond these names. Close to CM-LOY-005 Wishlists (WooCommerce's shopper lists are cited there); kept apart because BigCommerce puts it in B2B Edition, beside its own Wishlist API (BC-S-0214), and names it for reordering. The reviewer may nest it.

capability: Sales reps for business buyers: the merchant's sales staff assigned to buyers' companies (BigCommerce B2B Edition Sales Staff, Super Admin, Sales rep ordering)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: B2B Edition's API groups Sales Staff and Super Admin (the storefront Super Admin group's path is rest/b2b/storefront/sales-rep), the webhook topics store/superadmin/* and store/company/superadmin/assignmentUpdated, and the product line Sales rep ordering. That a Super Admin is a sales rep rests on that path, a reading; what a sales rep may do for a company isn't stated.

capability: Buyer portal: the business buyer's own part of the storefront (BigCommerce Buyer portal, B2B Edition Storefront APIs)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: the product line Buyer portal and B2B Edition's Storefront API group (rest/b2b/storefront). Neither is defined in a statement held: that the Storefront APIs serve the buyer portal is a reading on the names. The reviewer may fold it into CM-B2B-001, or nest it with CM-CUS-010 Customer accounts.

capability: Product recommendations: products the platform recommends to buyers on the storefront (BigCommerce Product Recommendations, Google Vertex AI)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: its API group Beta Product Recommendations, recommendations generated through Google Vertex AI and queried by the GraphQL Storefront API, in closed beta on Enterprise plans. Kept apart from CM-MKT-021 Upsell and cross-sell offers: no statement of any platform defines upsell or cross-sell, and none calls BigCommerce's recommendations either. The reviewer may nest them.

capability: Commerce data sent to outside analytics platforms and data warehouses (BigCommerce Big Open Data Solutions)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: its product line Big Open Data Solutions, which 'Connect[s] commerce data to BigQuery and leading analytics platforms including Tableau, Power BI, and Looker' (BC-S-0336). A place of its own (a product line), so not folded into CM-ANL-001. Kept apart from CM-ANL-006, which is apps reading the platform's reports through its API: BODS sends the store's data out to named platforms. Under CM-ANL-001 because BigCommerce's statement places it with analytics platforms and Q1 put it in BC-C-062 Reporting and analytics; no statement groups the product line under another, so the parent is a reading.
